hypothesis: A weekday-conditioned Dirichlet(0.5,0.5,0.5) SPX closing-direction distribution retaining exact-cent ties may improve expected-settlement-payout prediction versus an all-weekday historical frequency baseline.
target: Up token payout1/0.5/0 for rounded close rising/tied/falling; Down complementary. Ordinary completed reference-compatible sessions only; halt/fallback/cancellation risk remains unmodeled.
bootstrap: 1000 resamples of contiguous5-event blocks, seed2701; interval conditional on exploratory reconstruction
selection: shrinkage fitted on calibration only; heldout never used to choose weight
current_data_limitation: Downloaded historical closes have collected-now availability. Reconstruction is not point-in-time historical evidence, independently verified WSJ settlement or prospective trading.
